_comment: Component template shared by the three log data streams. CDC §7.4.
Extracted as a component so that a mapping change (a new field, a changed
type) is made once instead of three times and cannot drift between
streams — which is exactly what breaks a cross-service log query.

_meta.shards: 1 primary + 1 replica on 3 nodes: green with room to lose a node, and a single shard avoids the fixed per-shard overhead on small daily indices.
_meta.replicas: 1 and not 2. A second replica would cost 50% more disk for no availability gain: with 3 nodes, 1 replica already survives the loss of any one.
_meta.codec: best_compression (DEFLATE) instead of LZ4: logs compress extremely well and are read far less often than written. Roughly 15-20% less disk for a marginally slower search.
_meta.refresh_interval: 10s instead of the 1s default. Nobody needs sub-second log visibility, and a 10x lower refresh rate is a large reduction in segment churn and CPU.
_meta.dynamic: false, not strict: an unmapped field is stored in _source and remains visible in Kibana, but is NOT indexed. This stops a rogue application from creating thousands of fields (mapping explosion) while never losing data.
